in_pashto.name: سريحه

in_english.name: Sarihah
in_english.meaning: One who hastens to do good and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: Sarihah is derived from the Arabic root 'sarah', meaning to hasten or be quick in doing good and righteousness. This name holds significant spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition, reflecting a person's eagerness to perform virtuous deeds. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a commendable character trait of swiftness in benevolence and moral conduct
